name: ai-colorist-agent
description: Host-model photographic judgment, ready-to-use creative LUTs and a local OpenCV MCP grading pipeline. No training or GPT API calls required.

interface.longDescription: Inspect photos with your host model, select a ready-to-use look and apply it locally through MCP. Includes an optional source-dependent reference fitting tool.
interface.defaultPrompt: Inspect this photograph and grade it with AI Colorist, preserving useful highlight and shadow detail.
